info.title: Let's Split API
info.description: Versioned REST API behind the Let's Split app. Money is always integer paise. Every write accepts an Idempotency-Key header, and ids for new groups and expenses are generated on the device.

Bearer.description: Supabase Auth access token from the email-code sign in.

id.description: Generated on the device; replaying it returns the same group.

MemberCreate.description: Adds a placeholder member who can claim their spot later.

amount.description: Amount on the bill, in that currency

rate.description: Rupees per one unit of the currency

id.description: Generated on the device; replaying it never creates a duplicate.

payers.description: Who paid. Defaults to the caller paying the whole amount.

allOf.description: Set when the bill was in another currency; amountPaise is the converted total.

payers.description: Who paid. Defaults to the caller paying the whole amount.

allOf.description: Set when the bill was in another currency; amountPaise is the converted total.

id.description: Generated on the device; replaying it never records twice.

days.description: Every day of the trip (from its dates, else first to last expense), in India time.

peakDay.description: Biggest-spend day; `index` is 0-based into `days`, `topDescription` its largest expense.

chaiCount.description: Expenses named like chai / tea / coffee.

enabled.description: False when the server has no VAPID keys yet.

delivered.description: Devices that got the reminder. 0 means use WhatsApp instead.

inrPer.description: Rupees per one unit of each currency

updatedAt.description: When the source last published these rates
